facts.text: Point Park University operates the Pittsburgh Playhouse, a 90,000-square-foot learning and performance complex built for $60 million in Downtown Pittsburgh.

sources.title: Inside the Playhouse | Point Park University | Pittsburgh, PA
sources.quote: The 90,000-square-foot structure, which cost $60 million to build and furnish, is located on approximately 1.6 acres of land along the Forbes Avenue corridor between Wood and Smithfield streets.
